verdict.rationale: Brave ships its own official MCP server, which exposes web, local, image, video and news search plus summarization as agent tools. It also documents Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other agents, and guides for Claude Desktop. The Answers endpoint accepts natural-language questions and returns grounded answers, including a deep-research mode. Natural-language operation still depends on an external AI client, though, and only search and answer calls are covered, not the wider product. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface that needs no third-party agent host, natural-language control of account, key or plan management, and hands-on corroboration that NL-driven operation works in practice.
